film: SI MATH AI — THE AI COURT
document: VO line manifest — machine-readable source for the F-script record
rule: Picture is cut to the read, never the reverse. All lines are recorded before any dialogue shot is animated.
note_on_runtime: ~1:40–1:45 target; the edit owns the seconds, verified in animatic v3.

casting.status: HUMAN VO for JZ, LZ and ZERO — one actor, three registers. REP is diegetic synthetic (TTS by design).

human_roles.JZ: 18 lines — elder register: low, chest, settled, 0.7×. He never raises his voice; a look does the work.
human_roles.LZ: 8 lines — young register: forward, bright, crisp, momentum. Elite trial lawyer; delighted, never smug.
human_roles.ZERO: 1 line (F29) — the merged register: record three ways (elder, young, blended mid); the mix chooses. It must sound like both of them at once.

casting.rep_voice: Sincere, warm-competent, certain — a faint clean digital sheen added in the mix only. NEVER robotic; the wrongness lives in WHAT is answered. The only synthetic voice in the film belongs to the synthetic characters — diegetic, not a shortcut.

delivery_spec.naming: F01_JZ.wav … F29_ZERO.wav (F29 ×3 registers: F29a elder, F29b young, F29c blended)
delivery_spec.note: One file per line — each becomes the audio_references input to its shot's seedance_2_0 take.

tts_fallback.status: Emergency pickups only for human roles. REP lines are PRODUCTION TTS by design (diegetic).

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: Can you remember every mistake this student made?
lines.delivery: Cold, mid-trial, no preamble. The audience is asked too — and can't answer either.

lines.speaker: REP
lines.delivery: Instant, bright, certain, SINCERE. A perfect answer to a different question.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: Not sharp. Patient. Which is worse. Held beat, then the gavel.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: This court is now in session.
lines.delivery: Over the reveal. The trial formally begins after the audience has seen the defendants fail.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: Show this court the moment it broke.
lines.delivery: Placed, not raised.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.delivery: Rising INTO their silence — the momentum shift. Exhibit A ignites.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: And the why? Anyone can say 'wrong.'
lines.delivery: The dagger from authority; second sentence almost gentle.

lines.speaker: REP
lines.delivery: Begins rising, still confident — cut by THE LOOK. Sits. Never speaks again.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: Anyone can solve a problem. Very few can build a learner.
lines.delivery: Quiet, almost to himself, while ROOT CAUSE glows. Not addressed to them — which is why it lands on them. OWNER-AUTHORED.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: What kind of wrong was it?
lines.delivery: Real curiosity entering the authority.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: A concept gap. A calculation slip. Carelessness. Or time.
lines.delivery: Four beats on four claws, four icons, the jury-box walk. Ends as a statement.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: Eight times. Six weeks. Nobody noticed.
lines.delivery: Flat, no triumph; the timeline multiplies. The evidence answers before it is asked.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: Students don't fail in one question. They fail one step at a time.
lines.delivery: The film's intellectual heart, slowest line of Act II, over the timeline. B3 beneath it. OWNER-AUTHORED.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: And what becomes of that mistake?
lines.delivery: The first question that isn't an indictment — hope, disguised as procedure.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.delivery: Two words. The turn of the film. Warm.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.delivery: Soft; the NEXT LESSON card rises in the same breath as the plan.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: How far does this road go?
lines.delivery: The biggest question, asked smallest.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: First question to target score. The whole road — together.
lines.delivery: The path unrolls toward the bench; micro-pause before 'together.'

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.delivery: Literally true now. Music dies on the final word.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: Held on the Representatives. Generous, and true. No irony.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: But this one was built for students.
lines.delivery: THE VISUAL VERDICT: in the held second before the line, his eyes move slowly to Lawyer Zero and rest there.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: Solving a question is not the same as teaching a student.
lines.delivery: Pairs with the cold open's failure. OWNER-AUTHORED — replaced 'It does not just solve math.'

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: The thesis. Slowest read in the film.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: First law. Identical cadence with F25.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: Second law. Identical cadence with F24 — record back to back.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: Half-step softer; it resolves. Gavel on the final word.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: Mid-descent, cane-first. Not to anyone. To everyone.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.delivery: The only soft line he has. Then the simultaneous smile — and the silent merge as the long pause.

lines.speaker: ZERO
lines.delivery: After the merge. 2.5–3s dead-still eye contact BEFORE the fade. Record ×3 registers (elder / young / blended); the mix chooses. Then black. Logo only. One soft gavel tap.
